newsitem.title: HUNGARY: FIRST HUNGARY FUND BUYS OUT BUSMAKER FROM IKARUS.
newsitem.headline: FIRST HUNGARY FUND BUYS OUT BUSMAKER FROM IKARUS.

text.p: The First Hungary Fund (FHF), a financial investment group, bought the 21.34 percent stake in Hungarian-U.S. busmaker NABI Rt held by Hungary's state-owned busmaker Ikarus Rt, Hungarian news agency MTI Econews reported on Friday.
The deal makes FHF the sole owner of NABI, or North American Bus Industries, whose registered capital of 2.765 billion forints was not changed by the buyout, MTI said.
NABI announced earlier that it plans to have some of its shares traded on the Budapest Stock Exchange and the over-the-counter market in London.
The company, which assembles city buses in Alabama from chassis made in Hungary, reported net profit of $2.3 million on net sales of $77.8 million in 1996, Econews reported.
